statement: The complete section map of the full intrinsic rank-ten cubic pro3 class-two quotient N/gamma3N is evaluated. For every abelian section class alpha, explicit44-dimensional local Frobenius matrices and the eight framed cusp Kummer classes give a support vector D_q. Its unique correction in M/L must be integral at every prime of Q(zeta3) away3 and tend to zero. This is necessary and sufficient for a global lift. Every nonempty geometric-conjugacy fiber is a torsor under restricted Z3 sequences at rational primes p!=3, plus Z3^24, (Z/3)^9 and (Z/9)^5, with an exact45x45 cocycle presentation and saved Smith coordinate matrices.

notes: The actual integral generalized-Jacobian Tate lattice is fixed by the Weil pairing e3(A0,A2)=zeta and the translation definition; U rows(v,-u) give j=[3I;U]. The arithmetic peripheral term is negative kappa(z_d) wedge e_d, from the exact path-conjugation identity; the sign matches E31's residue2. All64 third-power cusp frame values are computed. Localization uses direct limit over finite prime supports before derived inverse limit, so the restricted-support convergence is retained. The invariant geometric Tate line L is primitive but its arithmetic Kummer class at3 need not be primitive; the natural fiber decomposition therefore uses primes p!=3 and24 unramified coordinates. The conjugate Frobenii at7 freely generate the rank2 pro3 Galois group, giving the exact cohomology evaluation map. Exact rational elementary row/column operations over Z3 certify seven unit, nine3 and five9 Smith factors, with24 free coordinates. The further metabelian and marked-depth lifting obstructions are not asserted to vanish. The actual frame sign was checked against Enge2015 section3 and Remark9, which explicitly resolves the contrary argument conventions in the opened Silverman source. The official lattice uses U=(v,-u); the exploratory opposite-sign lattice is related by diag(I2,-I8), and its wedge matrices by the exterior square of that exact basis map. The tangential Abel-Jacobi constant frames differ from z_d by the explicitly displayed order-two torus point epsilon_d; its compatible 3^m-division points are itself, so tensoring its canonical trivial Kummer torsor gives the exact pro3 path comparison. Formula (E37.22) also evaluates every abelian input: proper elliptic cohomology is Z3 plus Z/3 on the actual Frobenius generators; the selected representatives lift to V, and the remaining input is the unique toric Kummer class in two rational and three Eisenstein multiplicative completions.
